svg.title: Sony a6400 research status through E0314
svg.desc: 880 tests recorded passing. GPES BAR and IRQ contracts decoded using read-only camera observations. Opt-in engine model advances original guest code to a second signal, with labelled result-bit assumptions. Keyed completion and condition release remain open. No emulator GUI frame.

g.text: Research status
880 tests recorded passing | No verified emulator GUI frame
OFFLINE ORIGINAL CODE
UIPC / USB
VBUS callback completes; OTG input wakes UsbControl (wake-only).
Open: USB FSM transition and the missing MWF message producer.
READ-ONLY PHYSICAL EVIDENCE + OPT-IN MODEL
GPES engine / display
BAR / IRQ decoded; engine experiment reaches a second guest signal.
Open: keyed completion, guest condition release, OSD and rasterizer.
PHYSICAL OBSERVATION
PTP / composite USB
PC Remote sensor JPEG; composite enumeration demonstrated.
Open: composite frames and reliable teardown; paused.
AUTHORED PATTERN + PHYSICAL TRANSPORT
UVC / custom menu
Static 720p UVC at 29.9592 FPS; authored menu displayed.
Open: sensor feeder and original menu compatibility.
Independent results, not a compatibility percentage. Evidence and limits linked in README.
